title: Radius Studio Membership – Monthly (Cone 6 electric and Cone 10 gas firing access)
evidence_quote: Have your work fired in our cone 6 electric or cone 10 gas kilns (firing fees apply).
evidence_sentence: Monthly members get 24/7 studio access and can fire work in Cone 6 electric or Cone 10 gas kilns for $0.06/cubic inch.
how_to_join: Apply for membership; current wait time is approximately 3 months. Join waitlist through the website.
source_quote: Have your work fired in our cone 6 electric or cone 10 gas kilns (firing fees apply). The opportunity to learn to fire kilns and fire your own work (become kiln certified with us to have full control of firing your pieces).
summary: Ongoing monthly membership for artists with Cone 6 electric and Cone 10 gas kiln access. Members can become kiln-certified to fire independently; 6-month minimum initial commitment.
